_readme: Crown tower damage only. These are NOT area damage values.
_anchor: The global spell-vs-tower factor is 0.7660, fitted so a level 16 Fireball comes out at 253, which is what it does twice in videoplayback.mp4. See tools/build_spell_table.py.

_excluded.Poison: damage over time, does not reduce to a cast count
_excluded.Earthquake: damage over time, does not reduce to a cast count
_excluded.Tornado: deals no meaningful crown tower damage

Rocket.note: derived: the game's own per-level damage times this card's crown tower percentage times the global factor fitted on Fireball. Not checked against footage.
